narration.text: Why glass flows just 1 nanometre per billion years.
Old church windows didn't sag because of it.
A 2017 study checked glass in Westminster Abbey from 1268.
Even at its most fluid, that flow is far too slow to see.
Uneven panes came from how the glass was made and fitted.
Glass-making is at least 6,000 years old.
So glass is a solid, just one without a crystal pattern.
